artifact_review: The Router identified texture anomalies in the grass and slight boundary bleeding at the paws. The Pose Auditor flagged low confidence in the hind limbs (hips/knees), which correlates with the Router's observation of paw/grass blending. This is likely a minor artifact of generation or resolution rather than structural melting, given the high mask confidence (0.94) from the Topology Auditor. The severity of the grass texture anomaly (1.5) is appropriate for background noise that doesn't affect the subject's integrity.
alignment_reasoning: The fine-grained classifier strongly confirms the class (Australian Terrier) with a high logit score (7.85) and clear separation from similar breeds (Norwich/Silky). All visible anatomical checkpoints (head, ears, coat, tail) are present and conform to the taxonomy. The only untestable checkpoint is gait. The high alignment score reflects the precise breed characteristics captured.
artifact_reasoning: The image exhibits minor generative/compression artifacts. The background grass lacks fine detail (smudged/painterly), and there is slight softness/fusion where the paws meet the grass, supported by low-confidence keypoints in the hind legs from the pose auditor. However, the main body topology is solid (high mask confidence), and no catastrophic structural failures (extra limbs, melting torso) are present. The artifact score is penalized for the background quality and paw definition but remains high due to the subject's overall structural integrity.
